title: Pic proper curve divisibility component
statement: Let C be a proper smooth connected dimension-one curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves], with genus g [def-sc-genus], Picard group Pic(C) [def-sc-picard-group], and degree-zero subgroup Pic⁰(C) [def-sc-pic0]. Let n be a natural number whose image in k is nonzero. Then for every L in Pic⁰(C), there is M in Pic⁰(C) with M^n = L (tensor powers).

proof.text: The proper curve $C$ has dimension one by [def-sc-curves], so it is projective by [lem-sc-proper-dim-one-projective]. By [lem-sc-smooth-regular], all its local rings are domains. Hence distinct irreducible components cannot meet. The field spectrum is Noetherian, so finite type of $C$ over $k$ and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] make $C$ Noetherian. Its finitely many irreducible components are then also open; connectedness leaves exactly one. Thus $C$ is integral and is a curve in the sense of [def-pc-curve], projective and smooth in the sense of [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve]. As $C$ is nonempty and smooth over the separably closed field $k$, [lem-pc-rational-points-dense] gives $P\in C(k)$; [prop-pc-xk-integral] applied to $(C,P)$ now makes $C$ geometrically integral. Therefore [thm-sc-jacobian-representability] applies and identifies $\operatorname{Pic}^0(C)$ of [def-sc-pic0] with $J_C(k)$ for an abelian variety $J_C$ of dimension $g$: the genus in its statement agrees with [def-sc-genus] by [lem-pc-genus-agrees-sc].

source.place: ## Proof, first sentence; projectivity input Stacks Project Varieties Lemma 0A26 (varieties-lemma-dim-1-proper-projective)

proof.text: The image of n in k is nonzero, so n>0. Transport clause (d) of thm-av-final along the group equivalence between Pic⁰(C) and the Jacobian rational points from step 1. Given L, choose an nth root in the Jacobian and transport it back; the homomorphism law and injectivity prove M^n=L. The result stays in Pic⁰(C).

theorem Scheme.Hom.pic_proper_ntorsion_div
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : (n : k) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ L : C.Pic, L ∈ f.picZero → ∃ M : C.Pic, M ∈ f.picZero ∧ M ^ n = L
